title: Artisan vs 11x: Which AI sales platform fits your team?
snippet: Artisan and 11x both sell an AI sales rep that runs outbound for you, but they solve the job differently. Artisan is the better fit for most teams: one platform where Ava owns prospecting through booked meeting, with usage-based pricing and no seat fees. 11x offers multichannel outreach plus an AI phone agent and can suit a specific buyer.

title: Artisan vs 11x: Which AI SDR Wins in 2026 - moderninbound.com
snippet: Artisan's AI SDR Ava starts at roughly $1,500/month; 11x's Alice runs closer to $5,000 for comparable outreach volume.
